english.title: Stun adult bovine animal knacker's yard when not confined correctly to stunning pen
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[stunned]_
(B)_[caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to stun]_
(C)_[permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to stun]_

an adult bovine animal in a knacker's yard at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) when, at the time it was stunned, it was neither confined in a stunning pen which was in good working order nor was its head securely fastened in such a position so as to enable it to be stunned without infliction of avoidable pain, distress or suffering
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 30(1)(d) and 33(1) of, and paragraph 27 of Schedule 2 to, the Welfare of Animals at the Time of Killing (England) Regulations 2015.

other.penalty:
Summary: Fine

Time limit for prosecutions
6 monthsNote
Note that for offences committed since 12 March 2015, section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012 removes the limits on certain fines given by the Magistrates' Courts. Offences that were previously punishable by fines of 'prescribed sums' and that were limited to 'not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale' or 'not exceeding the statutory maximum', are now punishable by a fine of any amount.
